title: New Vendor checks the name only after typing or on Save & Close
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on Parts, Vendors.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Vendor".
  2. Click the Credit Terms dropdown without typing a name.
  3. Press Escape.
  4. Type "x" in Name.
  5. Delete the x.
  6. Click another field.
  7. Click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Vendor" window opens.

Step 2:

  • No "Name is a required field" message shows.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown closes.

Step 4:

  • The name reads x.

Step 5:

  • The Name field is empty.

Step 6:

  • The message "Name is a required field" shows.

Step 7:

  • The vendor is not saved and the message still shows.
  • No other new message appears.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S6-R5: “The Name field on New Vendor and Edit Vendor is checked only once the user has typed in it (then each time they leave it) or presses Save & Close with no name, because it used to show an error before the user had typed anything. See Story 11: Release day (S11-R7).”
  • S11-R7: “New Vendor and Edit Vendor no longer show "Name is a required field" as soon as the window opens and another field is clicked, which showed an error before the user had typed anything. The name is checked once the user has typed in it and leaves the field, or when they press Save & Close with no name.”
  • Story 6, Error Handling: “No new messages. Vendor save errors are unchanged.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
